What Pareto AI sells

Uses specialists’ judgment to create AI training data and tests.

  • Expert training data — Captures specialist judgment in medicine and law. Also covers STEM, finance, software and the humanities.
  • Forte — Experts register and are matched to projects. Matching is reviewed on an ongoing basis.
  • LEAPBench — Measures how efficiently models learn across repeated scientific design tasks. Also assesses their final results.
  • AttuneBench — Tests conversational emotional intelligence using participants’ own ratings.
